info.title: Image storage service
info.description: Documentation automatically generated by the swagger-autogen module.

post.description: Upload a single image file with optional metadata fields. The file must not exceed the configured UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE limit (default 100 MiB). Requests exceeding this limit return HTTP 413.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The image file to upload. Maximum size is controlled by UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE (default: 100 MiB).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Optional custom storage path for the image (e.g. folder/image.jpg). Must not contain '..' or be absolute.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON-encoded user-defined metadata object to associate with the image.

400.description: Bad Request — missing file, invalid path, or disallowed operator

413.description: Payload Too Large — uploaded file exceeds UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE

post.description: Import a previously exported ZIP archive. The archive must not exceed UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE (default 100 MiB). The number of extracted entries must not exceed IMPORT_MAX_ENTRY_COUNT (default 10000). The total uncompressed size of all entries must not exceed IMPORT_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_SIZE (default 10 GiB). Violations return HTTP 400 or HTTP 413 without extracting any files.

parameters.name: archive
parameters.description: ZIP archive to import. Accepted MIME types: application/zip, application/x-zip-compressed, application/octet-stream. Maximum size is controlled by UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE (default: 100 MiB).

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Optional JSON-encoded metadata object applied to all imported images that do not have metadata in the archive's mongodb_data.json.

400.description: Bad Request — missing file, unsupported MIME type, malformed archive, entry count limit exceeded, uncompressed size limit exceeded, or path traversal attempt

413.description: Payload Too Large — uploaded archive exceeds UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE
